description: Creates a payment request for the balance and returns where to pay: a payment link, or an address with the exact amount and network. Nothing is charged until the user pays it. Without sanctions_confirmed the tool creates nothing and returns the sanctions statement that the user confirms. method is a coin and network code (for example usdttrc20) or card. EU customers may see VAT added on top; the result shows the amount to pay.

amount_usd.description: Amount to credit, USD. Minimum 5 for USDT and USDC through our own gateway, 20 for other coins and card.

method.description: Coin and network code, e.g. "usdttrc20", or "card".

sanctions_confirmed.description: true when the user has confirmed the sanctions statement.

name: top_up
title: Top up the balance
